# Wailea Photo

> Family-owned and operated photography studio in Wailea, Maui, Hawaii, founded by Laurence Balter in 2000. Every session is photographed by one of four Balter family photographers - Laurence, Jude, Max or Solomon - across Wailea, Makena and South Maui. Known for natural color, authentic skin tones, hand-edited galleries, Leica cameras with APO-Summicron optics, and genuine Kodak film. Booked direct, with transparent prices.

Full reference: https://waileaphoto.com/llms-full.txt

## Facts
- Name: Wailea Photo - https://waileaphoto.com/
- Location: Wailea, Maui, Hawaii, United States. Sessions take place on beaches in Wailea, Makena and South Maui.
- Founded: 2000, by Laurence Balter. More than 25 years photographing Maui.
- Ownership: family-owned and operated, not a contractor-based photography directory.
- Photographers: Laurence Balter (founder and lead photographer), Jude Balter, Max Balter, Solomon Balter. Every session is photographed by one of them.
- Phone: +1-808-298-5188 - Email: photo@waileaphoto.com
- Delivery: galleries are hand-edited (no AI editing) and delivered within 24-72 hours; weddings and elopements, 200+ images within 24-48 hours.
- Reviews: 1,103 reviews averaging 5.0, counted listing by listing on 2026-11-12 - Tripadvisor 455 (three listings, including the Viator product page), Google 399, Facebook 123, Airbnb 94, Yelp 32. Reviews are hosted on those platforms; links are under "Verify our reviews".
- Not to be confused with the unrelated Kihei business "Wailea Photography".

## Sessions & Pricing
Starting prices; the exact price for a date, time and party size is shown in the live booking calendar before payment. Prices cover up to five people; additional guests $50 each unless noted. Current prices and booking: https://waileaphoto.com/pricing
- Sunrise with Max - 20 min, 25+ images, from $299
- First Half of Sunset - 30 min, 50+ images, from $449
- Last Half of Sunset - 30 min, 50+ images, from $499
- Turquoise + Water Experience - 45 min, 50+ images, from $399
- Maternity Experience - 45 min, from $499
- The Large Family Legacy - 1 hour, 100+ images, from $1200
- A Poetic Wedding in Maui - 90 min, 200+ images, from $2995
- Elopement Photography - 90 min, 200+ images, from $995

Notes: The Large Family Legacy covers up to 10 people, then $50 per person. A Poetic Wedding in Maui is the all-inclusive wedding package, tax included, for 2027 dates (2026 dates keep $2,599): Native Hawaiian officiant, bouquet, leis and arch, 1.5 hours of photography, beach permit, General Liability Insurance and live streaming; $100 deposit. Elopement Photography is photography only, for couples with their own officiant. The Signature Wedding ($4,800, by inquiry) adds a second photographer, Kodak black & white film and three hours.

## Booking
- Book online: https://waileaphoto.com/pricing - choose a date and time; a deposit reserves the session and the balance is due at the session.
- Questions: https://waileaphoto.com/faq or +1-808-298-5188.

## Photographic approach
- Guided but relaxed sessions built around real connection rather than stiff posing.
- Natural color and authentic skin tones; editing covers color and brightness, not body or skin retouching.
- Leica cameras; clients can choose the Leica APO-Summicron lens: https://waileaphoto.com/the-apo-difference
- Real Kodak film as an option: https://waileaphoto.com/kodak-film-upgrade - field comparison: https://waileaphoto.com/leica-m9-vs-kodak-portra-160
- Session timing follows the sun; locations are chosen for light, wind, tide and crowds.
